items.title: England captain Harry Kane is expected to miss ‘a few months’ with ankle injury
items.brief: England soccer captain Harry Kane will miss the “next few months” after tearing a ligament in his left ankle during Bayern Munich’s 1-1 draw against Cologne on Friday.

items.title: The FBI was hacked again, this time the breach targeted its crime database
items.brief: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its nationwide criminal information database that serves as a lifeline between federal, state and local law enforcement, two people briefed on the investigation said.

items.title: Navy won’t rename carrier slated to honor Black war hero after considering switching it to Trump
items.brief: The US Navy is no longer considering renaming an aircraft carrier under construction that was set to honor a Black sailor hailed for his heroic actions during the attack on Pearl Harbor.

items.brief: A federal judge has ordered the US Army to pause its plans to detonate five tons of lead azide on Monday after environmental activists filed a lawsuit expressing concerns about the potential impacts of the explosion.
